description.p: opencv_apps provides various nodes that run internally OpenCV's functionalities and publish the result as ROS topics. With opencv_apps, you can skip writing OpenCV application codes for a lot of its functionalities by simply running a launch file that corresponds to OpenCV's functionality you want.

ul.li: You can have a look at all launch files provided here.
Some of the features covered by opencv_apps are explained in the wiki.

description.p: The most of code is originally taken from https://github.com/Itseez/opencv/tree/master/samples/cpp
This is a ROS 2 (Humble) port by Claude (Sonnet 5) of the original ROS 1 nodelet-based package. Further updates and fixes made for ROS 2 (Jazzy)
